description: TY2026: charitable carryover under the OBBBA floor rule. Base 1,000,000; contributions 150,000 exceed the 100,000 ceiling -> deduction 90,000 (ceiling minus the 1% floor), and because the CEILING binds, everything not deducted carries: $60,000.00 (the 50,000 over-ceiling AND the 10,000 floored amount). Had the ceiling not bound, the floored amount would be permanently lost.
